thread:
Alex: Heads up — product is pushing a surprise weekday feature drop targeted at APAC 00:30 local. PM just told me to expect a traffic multiplier of ~3x baseline for ~45 minutes. Need a quick capacity hedge plan for GPUs and network. Can we cover this without disturbing EU/NA SLAs? :eyes:
Maya: How many concurrent sessions/reqs are they projecting? do we have a qps -> GPU mapping for that model?
Devon: They said ~1200 concurrent gen sessions peak. With current batching we need ~18 A100-equivalent GPUs to keep p95 < 350ms. That's rough.
Samira: Cost-wise that's a heavy spike for a surprise window. We can steal spare dedicated nodes in APAC if they're idle, or temporarily scale up hosted fleet with spot capacity if SLA can tolerate degraded tails.
Alex: Primary constraints: 1) regional capacity low in APAC this week (nodes reserved for a partner test) 2) can't change dedicated contracts right now.
Devon: Two real-time options: 1) quick prefix caching + tighter batching to reduce token work (software side, low-cost) 2) shift some inference routing to cross-region with gRPC proxying to EU-1 (adds ~30-50ms network) if app can tolerate it.
Maya: Do we have a simulation number for how much caching/batching will reduce GPU hours for that model?
Devon: Ran a 10min synthetic with prefix cache + 1.8x batching, result: token throughput doubled and estimated GPU hours cut by ~42% for the window. I can drop the test logs: ```summary: baseline 18 GPU-eq -> with cache+batch 10 GPU-eq; p95 increase ~+20ms```
Samira: If we still need 10 extra GPUs, pricing for spot in APAC would be ~0.55x on-demand cost. For hosted routing to EU, egress + cross-region networking would add ~$0.03 per request on average. Quick math: cheaper to do cache+batches + partial cross-region fallback for 30% of traffic.
Alex: Ok — plan proposal: 1) Enable prefix cache + increase batching target for that route 2) Add fallback policy: route excess requests to EU-1 when latency budget allows 3) Pre-warm two spare nodes in APAC (30 min prewarm) and set autoscale higher by 30% for 1 hour 4) Ops on-call watch the window.
Maya: I can flip the batching config and push a canary in 15m. Which route name? `prod/feature-x-gen`
Devon: I'll prepare the prefix-cache keys and the roll command. Use this quick command to enable short-term caching: ```sh
redwoodctl cache set prod/feature-x-gen --ttl 900 --mode prefix
redwoodctl scale pool apac-pool --min 2 --add 2 --until +1h
```
infra-bot: current apac capacity snapshot: `total_gpu_eq: 42, reserved: 28, available: 14, avg_tail_latency: 260ms`. Expected spare after partner reservations: ~6 GPUs.
Samira: That matches — we can't cover full 18 from APAC. So hybrid fallback is required.
Alex: Who's on-call? @Maya @Devon you lead ops during the window. Samira, coordinate cost alert threshold; set pager if estimated spend > $X for the hour.
Maya: On it. I'll push canary and set a live dashboard tile (latency, GPU utilization, cross-region fraction).
Devon: I'll stand by for routing flip. I'll also add a temporary throttle in the edge that drops to degraded model for 10% of lowest-priority requests if things tilt.
Samira: Setting a cost alert and a kill-switch runbook. If spend > 1.8x baseline for the hour we: 1) revert to degraded model 2) block cross-region fallback 3) scale down prewarmed nodes.
Alex: Perfect. Let's reconvene 10m before launch in here. Keep messages short and status updates. :thumbsup:
